verdict.rationale: Live customer support is a fair question for a fintech/expense SaaS like Ramp, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents live support channels, support hours, or urgent-issue escalation. The 'around the clock' claim describes AI agents doing finance tasks, not human customer support, and the support.ramp.com help-center articles are self-serve documentation, not live support.

support.subject: As a founder, I can reach live customer support at any time for urgent account issues
